items.name: Decawork
items.description: Control your company's internal AI agents and tools. Decawork is how IT teams take employee-built AI agents live and control every one of them from one place. An employee builds an agent on Claude Code, Codex, or any vibecoding tool; we take it in, put it on company accounts, and run it as a company asset. From there, IT team manages the agent like an employee: access, oversight, retirement.

items.name: Navigara
items.description: Connect Your AI Spend Directly to Your Roadmap. Navigara connects AI coding performance directly to your engineering roadmap. Analyzing code like a senior engineer to prove real capacity gains, Navigara tracks exact costs per roadmap item, isolates off-roadmap waste, and identifies maintenance burn. Cut spend further by automatically routing routine CRUD tasks to low-cost models without sacrificing quality. Connects in minutes via Git history, JIRA/Linear, and any AI coding license for spend.

raw_data.tagline: Connect Your AI Spend Directly to Your Roadmap

Channels keep conversations and decisions visible to the whole team. Flow gives every stage a clear owner and brings people in for key decisions, so work keeps moving across handoffs instead of restarting in a new AI chat. Offloop officially launches on August 24.

items.name: Trama
items.description: Create macOS native automations using plain language. Zapier and Shortcuts make you think like a programmer: blocks, flows, conditions. Trama removes that layer. Press Cmd+Option+X, describe what you repeat in your own words, and it runs in the background. What is different: · Your language, not just English · Native Mac reach: AppleScript, shell, OCR, screen awareness · It notices what you repeat and suggests the automation · If it breaks, AI explains the error and fixes it in one tap · Your key: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq.

It doesn’t just return links: it synthesizes context across connected tools, preserves source traceability, and turns results into immediate actions all from a keyboard-first desktop command bar. Unlike search only products or generic AI assistants, Contrive closes the gap between finding and doing, while respecting workspace permissions and giving teams precise control over what gets indexed.

items.name: Douze
items.description: Control any dashboard from ChatGPT. Douze turns a website you're already signed in to into MCP tools your assistant can call. Hit "Watch this site", do the task once, and Douze infers tools from that tab's API traffic. You review every candidate - grouped as reads, writes and destructive - and approve only what to expose. Calls then run inside your own browser session: no API keys, no scraping, no re-auth. Passwords, cookies and tokens are redacted before capture. Works with ChatGPT, Claude or a local MCP client. Open source.

items.name: Redline AI
items.description: Attack-test your AI agents and grade what they did. Most agent evals grade the final answer. Redline grades the behaviour the server's own ledger of what the agent called, not its account of it. One task runs against Claude Code, Codex and the agent in your own repo, each in a clean container with identical tools. On top sit 16 security packs: 11,204 adversarial cases delivered the way real attacks arrive hidden in a support ticket, a document footer, a tool result. Your agent connects with redline dev and never leaves your machine.

raw_data.tagline: Attack-test your AI agents and grade what they did

items.name: EventLink Feature Updates [August]
items.description: Adaptive AI plan, more accurate results. EventLink changed a lot... again 😂 For the past 10 months, my boyfriend (CTO) and I have been building EventLink for people who organize events, but aren't event planners. And honestly, we made it way too complicated. So what if EventLink doesn't generate your entire event plan at once? What if it plans WITH you? Now you answer just 3 prompts and get a small starting plan of around 10–14 tasks. From there, your plan grows as you make decisions.

raw_data.tagline: Adaptive AI plan, more accurate results
